title: D-091 / B-027: Linux systemd control-group containment the start and loop gates can prove, plus the POSIX worker self-kill fix
objective: Make the Linux loop able to start a live worker without weakening the containment rule (M0-T052 G5 C1): add a systemd control-group containment the start, post-cycle and turnover gates accept only when proved from inside the process (cgroup-v2 .service membership, KillMode control-group or mixed, ExitType=main, MainPID==self, SendSIGKILL=yes, bounded TimeoutStopSec), launch POSIX workers and probes in their own session, refuse to kill the caller's own process group, harden the unit template, add a Linux CI job, and prove it with positive, negative, mutation and bounded real-process tests. Reproduced defect: B-027 (project-control/reports/B-027-linux-containment-causal-trace.md).
business_reason: Owner directive D-091: move the loop to this cloud server (R001) and certify it before use (R007); B-027 blocks the commissioning canary.
